facts.text: The hotel is in the volcanic region of Haikou city on Hainan Island, China.
facts.excerpt: The Ritz-Carlton, Haikou is located in the volcanic region of Haikou city on the exotic Hainan Island of China.

facts.text: The hotel is built on ancient lava bedrock from extinct volcanoes, with rocky outcrops, jungle vegetation, lakes and wetlands that can be viewed from every room.
facts.excerpt: Built on top of a bedrock of ancient lava from extinct volcanoes, the dramatic landscape features rocky outcrops with striking variations of jungle vegetation, expansive lakes and wetlands which can be viewed from every room.

facts.text: It is the first golf resort of The Ritz-Carlton Hotel Company in China, adjacent to the 350-acre Blackstone Golf Course.
facts.excerpt: Welcome to the first golf resort of The Ritz-Carlton Hotel Company in China, which sets in adjacent to the legendary 350-acre Blackstone Golf Course.

facts.text: Mission Hills Resort, Haikou has 10 volcanic golf courses.
facts.excerpt: 10 volcanic golf courses of distinct quality offer golfers an amazing array of choices

facts.text: Dining includes Afternoon Tea at the Ritz-Carlton Bar & Lounge, all-day dining at Terra, Cantonese cuisine at Tin Lung Heen and the rooftop bar Flair.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy Afternoon Tea within the stately Ritz-Carlton Bar & Lounge, all-day dining at Terra, Cantonese cuisine at Tin Lung Heen and panoramic views from the rooftop bar, Flair.

facts.text: Tin Lung Heen, the Cantonese restaurant, has five private outdoor dining rooms.
facts.excerpt: Five private outdoor dining rooms are available.

facts.text: Flair is a rooftop lounge with views of the sunset and the golf course.
facts.excerpt: Admire the sunset and the golf course from this stylish rooftop lounge

facts.text: The spa offers a golf-inspired treatment and a ritual that combines coconut and Agar wood, local to Hainan.
facts.excerpt: Unwind after a day on the course with a signature, golf-inspired treatment, or surrender to a spa ritual born from Hainan’s unique landscape in which coconut and Agar wood are combined to inspire relaxation.

facts.text: The spa has a steam room, cool mist showers and indoor vitality pools.
facts.excerpt: the spa features a steam room, cool mist showers and indoor vitality pools.

facts.text: The Kids Club has a separate children's pool, playground games and toys for children aged 3 to 10.
facts.excerpt: The Kid’s Club offers separate children's pool and playground games and toys for kids aged from 3 to 10.

facts.text: The Club Lounge is on the 19th floor and has a classic European home-style design.
facts.excerpt: The 19th-floor Executive Lounge features classic European home-style design, renowned for its refined exclusive service.

facts.text: The TimeSDF Haikou Mission Hills Duty Free Shop is a 3-minute walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Only a 3-minute walk from hotel, this duty free shopping mall provides designer boutiques, restaurants and entertainment venues.

facts.text: The hotel does not provide a shuttle service.
facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

facts.text: Haikou Meilan International Airport is 16.0 km from the hotel.
The hotel's dress code asks guests to be smart casual at all times.
facts.excerpt: Our dress code is an important tradition. We appreciate that guests are dressed smart casual at all times.
